answer.worked:
At $t=0$:
$$\begin{align*}N&=1250e^{0.25(0)}\\N&=1250\end{align*}$$
The initial population is $1250$ koalas.

$$\begin{align*}N&=1250e^{0.25(12)}\\N&=1250e^3\\N&\approx25\,107\end{align*}$$
The population is approximately $25\,107$ koalas.

$5$ years $=60$ months.
$$\begin{align*}N&=1250e^{0.25(60)}\\N&=1250e^{15}\\N&\approx4\,086\,271\,716\end{align*}$$
The population is approximately $4\,086\,271\,716$ koalas.

entries.description:
Exponential Curves
An exponential relationship y = a^x produces exponential curve graphs.
Exponential curves have these features:
• An asymptote: a line the graph approaches but never reaches.
• The nature of the graph (growth or decay) depends on the sign of x.
• Consecutive y values change by a common ratio, which is the base number a.

Euler’s number e = 2.71828182845 ... has a unique property:
if f(x) = e^x

population growth, disease spread, radioactive decay, compound interest.
